== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[A Cunning Warrior]] (30 December 2024, [[:File:V24-L-acunningwarrior-PC-E1.png|V24-L-acunningwarrior-PC-E1.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (page 3). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
